title: If you’ve ever dreamed of finding the Genie’s lamp to make a wish, no...
transcript: Normally, the genie lives right over here, but apparently, this week he's moved. So we're gonna go find him. Where are you, Genie? I see it. Hi, Genie. Look at them. This lamp was built to honor the show's 10th anniversary. It weighs 12 pounds and it's 14 feet tall. And it's so beautiful, I can't get over it. You can come right to 47th of Broadway to check out the Genie's lamp in the middle of Times Square until June 15th. And then head to the New Amsterdam to see Aladdin on Broadway. Bye, Genie. You've never had a friend like me.
classificationReason: Promotional/tourism content showcasing Aladdin's 10th anniversary Genie lamp installation in Times Square — no first-hand opinion about the stage production itself.
